task_description: Build the HIJISTREAM mobile/TV application (Android TV/Google TV) using Expo React Native as specified in TDD.md. The app mirrors the existing web app functionality with TV-optimized navigation (D-pad, focus indicators) and uses AsyncStorage for caching.

verification.summary: Expo export (bun run export) bundles 2657 modules into dist/ successfully. Lint (bun run lint) passes with zero errors. No unit test framework was specified in TDD for the mobile app. Docker not applicable for Expo React Native.

fixes: WebView injectedJavaScript bridge for postMessage forwarding
useWindowDimensions hook in ContentGrid for reactive column count
Replaced ScrollView with FlatList in home screen to avoid nesting warning
Removed deprecated tvParallaxProperties prop from TVFocusable
skipped: Dual-cache staleness - intentionally matches web app behavior
Missing Zustand stores - TanStack Query + local state is simpler and works
